export_skeletal_animation_to_glb: build a python module to export world-space joint positions and rotations as a binary glTF 2.0 .glb file using GLBExporter.Export
convert_world_to_local_transforms: build a python module to convert world-space joint positions and rotations into local TRS values per joint using _world_to_local
build_glb_buffer_views_and_accessors: build a python module to accumulate raw bytes and emit glTF BufferViews and Accessors using the _BufferBuilder class
generate_cube_mesh_for_joints: build a python module to generate flat-shaded cube geometry with positions, normals, and indices for joint visualization using _cube_geometry
build_gltf_animation_channels: build a python module to construct glTF Animation objects with translation and rotation channels per joint using _build_animation
